associations.rationale: The formal type directly states or defines the item: For a multivariate polynomial ring indexed by Fin n over a field, the auxiliary value is the cast of n.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: A ring equivalence from R to S transfers the auxiliary property at the same index from S to R.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: For a small commutative ring, the auxiliary property at index d implies the property at index d + 1 for its polynomial ring.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: A small semisimple ring satisfies the auxiliary property in degree zero.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: An equivalence of abelian categories preserves the bound on projective dimension.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: A multivariate polynomial ring indexed by Fin n over a field satisfies the auxiliary property at index n.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: If a multivariate polynomial ring indexed by Fin n over a field has the auxiliary property at index d, then n is at most d.
